On some I219 devices
column2: ethernet cable plugging detection only works once

column1: from PCI D3 state. Subsequent cable plugging does set PME bit correctly
but device still doesn't get woken up.
Since I219 connects to the root complex directly
firmware (ACPI) to wake it up. In this case
works for first cable plugging but fails to notify the driver for
subsequent plugging events.
The issue was originally found on CNP
column2: but the same issue can be found

column1: on ADL too. So workaround the issue by continuing use PME poll after
first ACPI wake. As PME poll is always used
restriction for CNP can also be removed.
